timezone_note: KORAIL KTX train tickets release exactly 30 days in advance at 07:00 Korean Standard Time (KST). In San Francisco (Pacific Time), 07:00 KST is 3:00 PM Pacific Time on the previous calendar day!

booking_windows.leg: Day 8: Seoul Station -> Busan Station (KTX High-Speed Train)
booking_windows.action_item: Book 2 KORAIL Saver Pass seats or individual KTX tickets on KorailTalk app.

booking_windows.leg: Day 13: Busan Station -> Singyeongju Station (35-min KTX/SRT)
booking_windows.action_item: Reserve 2 KTX seats (or SRT tickets via website).

booking_windows.leg: Day 16: Singyeongju Station -> Seoul Station (Return KTX)
booking_windows.action_item: Book return KTX tickets for Sunday afternoon travel back to Seoul.

checklist_items.task: Download Naver Map & KakaoMap on both iPhones and set language to English.
Install Kakao T app and verify 'General Taxi -> Pay to Driver' option works without Korean credit card.
Review WOWPASS airport kiosk locations at Incheon Airport T1/T2 for USD cash exchange.
Plan to purchase two 5-Day Seoul Climate Cards (15,000 KRW each) for Days 1-5 in Seoul.
Set calendar alarms in SF for Oct 07, Oct 12, and Oct 15 at 3:00 PM PDT to reserve KTX tickets.
Order KT / SK Telecom / LG U+ roaming eSIM QR codes for 23 days of unlimited data.
